question: Which divine forms preside at Maṇikūṭa and at Vindhyaparvata?
premises: Maṇikūṭe names the first sacred site.
Hayagrīvo is the presiding form there.
Vinduparvate names the second sacred site.
Varāho is the presiding form there.
inference: Hayagrīva presides at Maṇikūṭa and Varāha presides on Vindu mountain.
plain_english: At Maṇikūṭa is Hayagrīva, and at Vindu mountain is Varāha.
